name: touchportal-meldstudio-plugin
description: Touch Portal integration with Meld Studio

scripts.start-dist: npm run clean && tsc && node dist/index.js
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && node builders/build.js
scripts.build-win: npm run clean && tsc && node builders/build.js -p Windows
scripts.build-mac: npm run clean && tsc && node builders/build.js -p MacOS
scripts.build-mac-arm: npm run clean && tsc && node builders/entry.mjs && node builders/build.js -p MacOS-Arm64
scripts.full-build: npm run clean && tsc && node builders/entry.mjs && node builders/build.js

author: Jameson Allen (aka Spdermn02)
